faq.title: A few things to know
faq.bannerQuestion: Why does a banner appear when I open an app?
faq.bannerAnswer: iOS may show a banner when an app opens through Shortcuts. This is part of iOS and Vibeset cannot remove it.
faq.automaticQuestion: Can Vibeset set up every icon automatically?
faq.automaticAnswer: iOS does not allow apps or websites to change other app icons automatically. Each shortcut needs this one-time setup.
